chapter: Trent's band: Arkansas, Dallas and the Adolphus
title: Holder let go as manager and his replacement
summary: Holder is dismissed after losing the manager's job; the replacement is a decent player with a poor tone, and Chester Clark is praised.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x:
HE ASKED ME TO SEND HIM THE BUS PICTURE. WHICH I IN-
TEND TO DO, I HAVE TO GET A COPY OF IT. I MEAN I HAVE
A COPY. THIS ONE WAS ON A POSTCARD. DIDN'T THEY SEND
THIS OUT AS A POSTCARD. THIS MUST HAVE BEEN ONE OF THE
FOLLOWERS, BECAUSE WHAT'S HIS NAME, B? SAW THIS PICTURE
RIGHT?
That is B?

WHERE DID YOU GET HIM FROM. HE MUST HAVE TAKEN OVER
HOLDER'S PLACE. WAS HOLDER FIRED, OR HE DID HE QUIT
ON HIS OWN?
Holder was let out.
SAME THING, STILL FIDDLING WITH THE MONEY OR JUST TOO HARD TO GET ALONG WITH.
Well, after they took the manager's job away from him, he got a little AGITATED
Yeah. So
WHERE DID YOU GET HIM?
I don't remember exactly where we got him.
HOW GOOD A MUSICIAN WAS HE.
I think he was a pretty good musician, but frankly I wasn't as happy with him as I was with Holder.
HOLDER WAS PRETTY OUTSTANDING.
Holder was an outstanding musician.
R? JUST WAS A GUY, WHO COULD READ ALRIGHT, BUT HE DIDN'T HAVE A GOOD TONE MAYBE?
No, I didn't particularly care for his tone. Holder did have, I've always have been one for tone.
OH YEAH.
And
WHEN YOU HEAR GUYS LIKE JOE SMITH, THAT'S THE WAY TO PLAY. IF YOU CAN GET THAT, NOT TOO MANY PEOPLE CAN.
Well, Chester Clark did.
YEAH. CHESTER CLARK'S ON THIS PICTURE. HE'S A GOOD LOOKING GUY.
